aka.zh: 斯基纳公路（鲁珀特王子港至特勒斯，1944 年）
“泪之路”（鲁珀特王子港至乔治王子城）

tagline.en: British Columbia's northern cross-province road, from Haida Gwaii up the Skeena to the Yellowhead Pass
tagline.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省北部的横贯公路：自海达瓜伊沿斯基纳河而上，直抵黄头山口

start.en: Masset on Graham Island, Haida Gwaii, the western end of the Yellowhead Highway; the island section ends at the Skidegate ferry, and the mainland road starts at Prince Rupert
start.zh: 海达瓜伊格雷厄姆岛上的马塞特，黄头公路的西端；岛上路段止于斯基德盖特渡口，大陆路段始于鲁珀特王子港

end.en: The Alberta boundary at the Yellowhead Pass on the Continental Divide, where the road continues into Jasper National Park
end.zh: 大陆分水岭上黄头山口处的阿尔伯塔省界，道路由此进入贾斯珀国家公园

en: Highway 16 is British Columbia's part of the Yellowhead, the northern Trans-Canada route. It begins on Haida Gwaii, where 101 km of road run from Masset down Graham Island to the ferry at Skidegate. A BC Ferries crossing of the Hecate Strait, about 93 nautical miles, takes it to Prince Rupert, and from there the mainland road runs about 1,072 km to the Alberta boundary.

East of Prince Rupert it follows the Skeena River through the Coast Mountains to Terrace, then the Bulkley to Smithers and Houston, crosses the lake country of Burns Lake, Fraser Lake and Vanderhoof to Prince George, and turns up the Fraser past McBride to Tête Jaune Cache, where Highway 5 leaves for Kamloops. The last stretch climbs through Mount Robson Provincial Park to the Yellowhead Pass at 1,131 metres. For most of the way it keeps company with the northern line of the Canadian National Railway.

The 720 km between Prince Rupert and Prince George have another name. Women, most of them Indigenous, have disappeared or been murdered along it since 1970, and it has been called the Highway of Tears; until 2017 the corridor had almost no public transport, and hitchhiking was a common way to travel between its communities.
zh: 16 号公路是黄头公路——北线横加公路——在不列颠哥伦比亚省的部分。它始于海达瓜伊：101 公里的道路自马塞特沿格雷厄姆岛南下，至斯基德盖特渡口。经卑诗渡轮横渡赫卡特海峡约 93 海里抵达鲁珀特王子港，大陆路段由此向东延伸约 1,072 公里至阿尔伯塔省界。
出鲁珀特王子港后，它沿斯基纳河穿过海岸山脉到特勒斯，再沿巴克利河到史密瑟斯与休斯敦，穿越伯恩斯湖、弗雷泽湖与范德胡夫一带的湖区到乔治王子城，然后沿菲沙河上溯，经麦克布赖德到泰特若纳卡什，5 号公路在此分出通往坎卢普斯。最后一段穿过罗布森山省立公园，爬升至海拔 1,131 米的黄头山口。全程大部分路段与加拿大国家铁路北线相伴。
鲁珀特王子港至乔治王子城之间的 720 公里还有另一个名字。自 1970 年以来，沿线不断有女性失踪或遇害，其中多数是原住民，这段路因此被称为“泪之路”。直到 2017 年，这条走廊几乎没有公共交通，搭便车是往来沿线社区的常见方式。

en: The road was assembled from the middle outwards. The Prince George–New Hazelton section opened in August 1925, when the Burns Lake–Endako link was finished. The number 16 was first given in 1941, to a road from New Hazelton east to Aleza Lake; its western end moved to Prince Rupert in 1948, and in 1953 the highway was realigned to end at Prince George.

The road to the coast was a wartime project. After the United States entered the Second World War, contracts were let in 1942 for a highway from Terrace to Prince Rupert, partly on land taken from the Canadian National right of way, with the track moved aside. Two men were killed in February 1943 when snowslides buried a construction camp near Kwinitsa. The Skeena Highway opened in September 1944, a narrow road hugging the tracks that was not ploughed the following winter; the federal government held it until the province took it over in 1946, and it was paved in 1951.

East of Prince George the highway was built through to Tête Jaune Cache and the Yellowhead Pass by 1968 and brought to all-weather standard in 1969. The Yellowhead Highway across the four western provinces was officially opened in 1970, and from 1990 it carried the green Trans-Canada marker. The Haida Gwaii section was added to Highway 16 in 1983.

In the autumn of 2005 the RCMP set up Project E-PANA to review unsolved cases along the highway. By 2007 it covered 18 cases, 13 murders and five disappearances of women and girls between 1969 and 2006 near Highways 16, 97 and 5; Indigenous organisations put the number in northern British Columbia above 40. The first of the 33 recommendations of the 2006 Highway of Tears Symposium was a shuttle bus along the corridor. It took a decade: the province's Highway 16 Transportation Action Plan was announced in December 2015, and BC Transit began new intercommunity routes in 2017.
zh: 这条路是从中间向两端拼接起来的。乔治王子城至新黑兹尔顿段于 1925 年 8 月随伯恩斯湖至恩达科连接段完工而开通。“16 号”编号于 1941 年首次授予，当时指新黑兹尔顿东至阿勒扎湖的道路；1948 年西端移至鲁珀特王子港，1953 年改线以乔治王子城为终点。
通往海岸的路段是战时工程。美国参加第二次世界大战后，特勒斯至鲁珀特王子港公路于 1942 年发包，部分路段占用了加拿大国家铁路的用地，铁轨为此改道。1943 年 2 月，雪崩掩埋了奎尼察附近的一处施工营地，造成两人死亡。斯基纳公路于 1944 年 9 月开通，只是一条紧贴铁轨的狭窄道路，当年冬天甚至没有除雪；战后联邦政府继续掌管，直到 1946 年由省政府接手，1951 年铺装。
乔治王子城以东路段于 1968 年修通至泰特若纳卡什和黄头山口，1969 年达到全天候标准。横贯西部四省的黄头公路于 1970 年正式开通，1990 年起使用绿色的横加公路标志。海达瓜伊路段于 1983 年并入 16 号公路。

2005 年秋，加拿大皇家骑警设立 E-PANA 专案，复查沿线悬案。到 2007 年，专案涵盖 18 宗案件——1969 至 2006 年间发生在 16、97、5 号公路附近的 13 宗女性遇害案和 5 宗失踪案；原住民组织则认为，不列颠哥伦比亚省北部的实际人数超过 40。2006 年“泪之路”研讨会提出的 33 项建议中，第一项就是沿走廊开设穿梭巴士。这花了十年：该省于 2015 年 12 月公布“16 号公路交通行动计划”，卑诗交通公司于 2017 年开通新的城际线路。

en: No construction cost has been published for the highway as a whole. The best-documented spending on it in recent years is not on the road itself but on getting people along it safely: the Highway 16 Transportation Action Plan began at $3 million in December 2015, grew to $5 million in June 2016 with $1 million from Indigenous and Northern Affairs Canada for bus shelters and webcams, and the ministry now gives a total of $10.2 million in provincial and federal funding through 2024/25.
zh: 这条公路从未公布全线造价。近年记录最清楚的开支并不在道路本身，而在于让人们安全地沿路出行：“16 号公路交通行动计划”于 2015 年 12 月以 300 万加元起步，2016 年 6 月增至 500 万加元，其中加拿大原住民与北方事务部出资 100 万加元用于候车亭和摄像头；交通部目前公布的省级与联邦出资总额为 1,020 万加元，截至 2024/25 财年。

value.en: About 1,173 km of road: 101 km on Haida Gwaii and 1,072 km on the mainland, as cited in English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 16, from the ministry's Landmark Kilometre Inventory (2017). The Skidegate–Prince Rupert ferry adds about 93 nautical miles.
value.zh: 道路全长约 1,173 公里：海达瓜伊 101 公里，大陆 1,072 公里，据英文维基百科“不列颠哥伦比亚 16 号公路”条目所引交通部《地标公里清单》（2017 年）。斯基德盖特至鲁珀特王子港渡轮另有约 93 海里。

figures.source: English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 16 (citing BC Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure, Landmark Kilometre Inventory, January 2017)

why.en: No route-wide or sectional construction cost was found in a published source. The road was built piecemeal from the 1920s to 1969, partly as a wartime project.
why.zh: 公开资料中未找到全线或分段造价。这条路自 20 世纪 20 年代至 1969 年分段修建，部分为战时工程。

value.en: The province. The Terrace–Prince Rupert section was held by the federal government after the war until British Columbia took it over in 1946; Ottawa contributed $1 million to the Highway 16 Transportation Action Plan in 2016.
value.zh: 省政府。特勒斯至鲁珀特王子港段战后由联邦政府掌管，1946 年移交不列颠哥伦比亚省；2016 年联邦政府为“16 号公路交通行动计划”出资 100 万加元。

figures.source: Septer, Highway 16: Prince Rupert–Terrace 1944–1994, BC Historical News 29(1), 1995, as cited in English Wikipedia; BC Government news release 2016TRAN0137-001042, 15 June 2016

value.en: $3 million (December 2015); $5 million including federal funding (June 2016); $10.2 million in provincial and federal funding through 2024/25.
value.zh: 300 万加元（2015 年 12 月）；含联邦出资后 500 万加元（2016 年 6 月）；截至 2024/25 财年省级与联邦出资共 1,020 万加元。

figures.source: CBC News, 14 December 2015; BC Government news release 2016TRAN0137-001042; BC Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure, Highway 16 Transportation Action Plan page

value.en: 18 cases, 13 homicides and five missing-person investigations, dated 1969 to 2006, of women and girls last seen or found near Highways 16, 97 and 5. Indigenous groups put the number in northern British Columbia above 40.
value.zh: 18 宗案件，包括 13 宗凶杀案和 5 宗失踪案，时间跨度 1969 至 2006 年，受害者均为在 16、97、5 号公路附近最后被目击或被发现的女性。原住民团体认为不列颠哥伦比亚省北部的实际人数超过 40。

figures.source: RCMP, Project E-PANA, September 2012; The Canadian Encyclopedia, Highway of Tears

timeline.en: The Prince George–New Hazelton road opens in August with the completion of the Burns Lake–Endako link.
timeline.zh: 8 月，伯恩斯湖至恩达科连接段完工，乔治王子城至新黑兹尔顿的道路开通。

timeline.en: The number 16 is first assigned, to the road from New Hazelton to Aleza Lake.
timeline.zh: “16 号”编号首次授予新黑兹尔顿至阿勒扎湖的道路。

timeline.en: The wartime Skeena Highway from Terrace to Prince Rupert opens in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，战时修建的特勒斯至鲁珀特王子港斯基纳公路开通。

timeline.en: The province takes over the Skeena Highway from the federal government.
timeline.zh: 省政府从联邦政府手中接管斯基纳公路。

timeline.en: The new road east of Prince George to the Yellowhead Pass is brought to all-weather standard and opened to traffic.
timeline.zh: 乔治王子城以东至黄头山口的新路达到全天候标准并开放通行。

timeline.en: The Yellowhead Highway is officially opened across Western Canada.
timeline.zh: 黄头公路在加拿大西部正式开通。

timeline.en: The Haida Gwaii road from Masset to Skidegate becomes part of Highway 16.
timeline.zh: 海达瓜伊马塞特至斯基德盖特的道路并入 16 号公路。

timeline.en: The RCMP sets up Project E-PANA in the autumn to investigate unsolved cases along the highway.
timeline.zh: 秋季，加拿大皇家骑警设立 E-PANA 专案，调查沿线悬案。

timeline.en: The Highway of Tears Symposium in Prince George makes 33 recommendations, the first a shuttle bus along the corridor.
timeline.zh: 乔治王子城的“泪之路”研讨会提出 33 项建议，第一项为沿走廊开设穿梭巴士。

timeline.en: The province announces a $3 million Highway 16 Transportation Action Plan in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，省政府公布 300 万加元的“16 号公路交通行动计划”。

timeline.en: BC Transit begins new intercommunity bus routes along the corridor.
timeline.zh: 卑诗交通公司沿走廊开通新的城际巴士线路。
